issues.evidence: MCP73871 THERM (pin 5) net /BATT_THERM connects only to R26 (10k to GND) and J5 (optional NTC solder pads). R26 is marked DNP (dnp yes) and J5 is in_bom=no / labelled 'OPTIONAL BATTERY NTC'.
issues.why_it_matters: In the default build THERM floats; the 50 uA THERM source pulls it above the cold threshold, so the charger reports a temperature fault and does not charge. R26 must be fitted when no NTC is used (10k to VSS is the documented way to disable thermistor sensing).

issues.evidence: 2-layer board; USB D+/D- (~71-73 mm, F.Cu, 0.25 mm) run from J2 (y~143) to R34/R35 (y~81). B.Cu GND pour only spans y 56-125 and is cut by B.Cu routing: ~42 mm of D+ and ~41 mm of D- have no GND copper beneath (computed from filled zone polygons).
issues.why_it_matters: USB FS from the ESP32-S3 is tolerant, but an unreferenced 70 mm pair radiates and is susceptible to ESD/noise near the connector; a solid return under the pair is cheap to add.

issues.evidence: Camera XCLK (20-24 MHz) has 20.5 mm on B.Cu with no plane on F.Cu and ~23 of 29.5 mm unreferenced in total; PCLK ~10.7 of 16.6 mm unreferenced; DVP data lines similar.
issues.why_it_matters: Fast camera clocks without a return plane add ringing/EMI and can corrupt DVP capture next to the Wi-Fi module.

issues.evidence: C24 22 uF directly on USB VBUS (+5V) at the MCP73871 input.
issues.why_it_matters: USB spec limits device VBUS capacitance at attach to 10 uF (inrush); most hosts tolerate it.

issues.evidence: VPCC divider R27 330k / R28 110k from +5V: VPCC loop (1.23 V) engages at ~4.92 V input.
issues.why_it_matters: With normal USB cable droop (4.75 V) the MCP73871 will throttle charge current, giving slow charging; ~4.5 V is more typical.

issues.evidence: ICS-43434 SD (pin 6) goes straight to GPIO6 and header J4 with no pull-down.
issues.why_it_matters: InvenSense recommends ~100k pull-down on SD to discharge the line while the mic tri-states the unused slot; otherwise the ESP may sample floating data unless an internal pull-down is enabled.

issues.evidence: LCSC fields with stray whitespace: R3/R30 ' C21190' vs R37/R39/R40 'C21190'; J1/J6 'C131337 '. C32 10u uses LCSC C90053 while other 10u 0603 caps use C19702. Many passives (all 0.1u/1u caps, R2, R6, R9...) have no LCSC number at all.
issues.why_it_matters: Same part splits into multiple BOM lines or fails LCSC matching at assembly upload.

issues.evidence: R25 PROG3 (termination current) value '25k', not an E24/E96 value (24k / 24.9k / 25.5k).
LiPo connector J1 (JST-PH) goes straight to MCP73871 VBAT with no reverse-polarity protection; USB VBUS has no fuse/TVS (U5 SRV05-4 VP is on +3V3, protecting data lines only).
issues.why_it_matters: JST-PH LiPo polarity is not standardised between vendors; a reversed pack destroys the charger. Typical hobby risk.

issues.evidence: D2/D3 have value "LED" with no MPN, LCSC or colour, while about half the BOM (e.g. R1 C15401) carries LCSC numbers. The LED part and colour are unspecified for ordering.

acceptable_designs.reason: R36 0R bypasses the TPS22919 camera load switch but is marked DNP: a population option only.
R31 (PIR to GPIO42/CAM_PWR_EN) is DNP, so the PIR output does not fight GPIO42.
Autofocus supply 0R links are DNP options with test points.
0R strapping MAX98357A GAIN_SLOT to VDD (6 dB gain) is intentional and leaves a gain-option footprint.
IO35-37 are used internally by octal PSRAM on WROOM-1 N*R8 modules and must stay unconnected ('PSRAM' note).
D+ has 2 vias and ~1.4 mm more length than D-; irrelevant at USB full-speed 12 Mb/s (the S3's only USB mode).
SCCB pull-ups go to the camera's 2.8 V DOVDD on purpose, so the OV5640 never sees 3.3 V; the ESP32 VIH (~2.48 V) is still met.
Resistive dividers (680/3k9, 10k/56k) bring the ESP's 3.3 V outputs to ~2.8 V for the camera; this is intentional.
The WROOM-1 module has internal decoupling; C1 10u + C2 0.1u sit ~6 mm from pin 2.
Unused open-drain status outputs, NC pins, SBU and unused TVS channel are left open on purpose.
The DS8561-15S3 SOT-23-3 pinout (1 GND, 2 VOUT, 3 VIN) matches the XC6206 symbol used.
The charger STAT1 LED has R2 2k from +5V; status LED D3 has R3; the doorbell button LED has R9.

[wrong] The footprint is KiCad Connector_USB:USB_C_Receptacle_HRO_TYPE-C-31-M-12, made for this exact part: A1..B12 signal pads plus 4 shell tabs all numbered SH. The extra count comes from counting SH as a pin; the part fits.

notes: Checked these pinouts from memory against the netlist and PCB pads: ESP32-S3-WROOM-1, MCP73871 QFN-20, TPS63802 DLA (FB divider 511k/91k gives 3.31 V at VFB 0.5 V), MAX98357A TQFN-16, ICS-43434, SRV05-4, TPS22919, XC6206. All consistent. I did not verify the OV5640 24-pin FPC orientation (Hirose FH12 contact side vs the reversed CAM1..24 numbering in the custom symbol); check it against the actual camera flex before ordering. The MCP73871 THERM-float behaviour is based on memory of the datasheet, not re-read. U1, MK1, J5 and J9 are in_bom=no (hand-fit). The long I2S BCLK/WS runs (GPIO4/5, ~120-140 mm, shared with the J4 header) are noted but not flagged. Other LCSC part numbers (C84419, C90053, C202112, C131337) were not looked up.
